title: name across a line break
text:
Querida Ana
Ruiz, adjunto el contrato.

title: IBAN with irregular grouping
why: The IBAN pattern wants groups of four. Irregular grouping is not recognised, and the leak check only watches values it already found.

title: phone across two lines
why: Separators in a phone number may be spaces, dots or dashes, not newlines. The first digits are replaced and the tail stays.

title: email broken by a soft wrap
text:
Escribe a ana@gestoria-
norte.example si hay dudas.
why: The address pattern does not cross a line break, so the end of the domain survives the wrap.

title: IBAN split over two lines
why: Same grouping rule as S2, the newline breaks the run of groups. The tail is caught as a number, the head is not.

title: surname broken by a hyphen and a line wrap
text:
Contacto: Ana Ru-
iz de Gestoría
why: A hyphen and a line break inside a surname split it. The first name is replaced, the surname is not a known form.
